scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter frontend run dev" "pnpm --filter backend run start:dev"
scripts.build:shared: pnpm --filter @sunub/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @sunub/types run build && pnpm --filter @sunub/utils run build
scripts.test:fe:e2e:docker: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/work/ -w /work/ -it mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.60.0-noble /bin/bash -c "npm install -g pnpm && pnpm install && pnpm --filter frontend run test:e2e"
scripts.test:e2e:update-snapshot: docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/work/ -w /work/ -e PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEB_SERVER=1 -e PLAYWRIGHT_FRONTEND_URL=http://host.docker.internal:4004 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.60.0-noble /bin/bash -c "npm install -g pnpm && pnpm --filter frontend exec playwright test"
scripts.test:fe:e2e:update: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/work/ -w /work/ -it mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.60.0-noble /bin/bash -c "pnpm install && pnpm --filter frontend run test:e2e:update"
